about.title: About Macro Calculator - Macronutrient Distribution
about.description: The Macro Calculator determines your optimal macronutrient distribution (protein, carbohydrates, and fats) based on your goals, activity level, and body composition. Proper macro balance is essential for muscle building, fat loss, and overall health. Understanding macronutrient ratios helps optimize your nutrition for specific fitness goals, whether you're trying to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain your current physique.

faq.q: What are macronutrients and why do they matter?
faq.a: Macronutrients are the three main nutrients your body needs in large amounts: protein (4 cal/g), carbohydrates (4 cal/g), and fats (9 cal/g). Each serves different functions - protein for muscle building and repair, carbs for energy, and fats for hormone production and nutrient absorption.

faq.q: How much protein do I need for my goals?
faq.a: Generally 0.8-1.2g per pound of body weight for sedentary individuals, and 1.2-2.2g per pound for active individuals and athletes. For muscle building, aim for the higher end (1.6-2.2g/lb), while maintenance can use moderate amounts (1.0-1.6g/lb).

faq.q: Should I track macros or just calories?
faq.a: Tracking macros provides better body composition results than calories alone, especially for muscle building and fat loss goals. Macros ensure you get adequate protein for muscle preservation and optimal nutrient distribution for your specific goals.

faq.q: Can I adjust the macro ratios based on my preferences?
faq.a: Yes, macro ratios can be adjusted based on personal preferences, dietary restrictions, and how your body responds to different approaches. The calculator provides starting points, but you can modify ratios while maintaining your calorie target for your goals.
